skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the concept of environment, structure, and function of the environment, and the impacts of human activities on the environment. Grasp the history of the formation of natural environmental components, characteristics of natural environmental components, and current issues related to these components.

Understand the levels of ecological organization, the relationship between components of the ecosystem, and the productivity of the ecosystem. Grasp issues related to renewable and non-renewable resources, the degree of exploitation, and the risk of depletion.

Apply knowledge of environmental science to explain natural phenomena and analyze the impact of human activities on the environment. Develop independent and team skills to solve environmental management issues.
Develop the ability to independently seek information, evaluate, analyze, and present information about the environment, both individually and in groups.
Develop the ability to work independently and in teams, with a sense of responsibility and discipline, and a sense of social responsibility.
Develop the ability to learn independently, find information to complete assignments and solve practical problems.
Develop the ability to communicate effectively, present ideas clearly, and engage in discussions.
